notes: §1985:VII.2.12.3 SR1: "File-name-1 must be a sequentially organized file." FileControlBinder.IoControl#ScreenRerunClauses (called from BindIoControl after the whole I-O-CONTROL paragraph, at every edition; the edition pass accepts RERUN at 85 and refuses it from 2002 with COBOL0902) takes the ON word as file-name-1 when it names a visible file and refuses it with COBOL6529 unless IsSequentiallyOrganized (sequential organization and not an SD, kb/Work PB5312). Probes at 85: ON implicit-sequential and explicit ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL files accepted with END OF REEL and condition-name forms; ON relative (dynamic access), indexed and SD files refused with COBOL6529 under END OF REEL, END OF UNIT, condition-name and RECORDS forms (RECORDS also draws SR3's COBOL6530); ON an undeclared word is implementor-name-1 and accepted. Witness: ON a relative file refused.

next.reason: 1985: "File-name-1 must be a sequentially organized file."; 2023: "No RERUN clause among the candidates; none covers the RERUN feature or this requirement.". The rule restricts the RERUN clause. No 2023 candidate covers RERUN, and the hits are file-name-1 rules for other statements and clauses, so 2023 lacks the feature here.
